extraction: runtime. Every vector is the return value of CostCalculator.calculate_cost, .calculate_granular_cost, .pricing_source, .deprecation and .price_checked for the shipped llm_pricing.json. `resolved_key` and `estimated_param_count_billions` come from the private _normalize_model_name / _extract_param_count_from_model_name helpers so a port can see WHY a price was chosen. `priced` is derived by this generator from those two (see SCHEMA.md). Model ids for kind=regression_test are read with ast from the literal lists in tests/test_pricing_substring_boundaries.py and tests/test_pricing_new_models.py.
